purpose: Implement concrete, unregistered PM Return journal reservation/storage and strict I07 observation codec with an unapplied new schema artifact.
publication_policy: Parent sole publisher; isolated worker; independent review and exact-head/base CI.
sql_policy: No real SQL connection/execution, schema application, database creation/drop, service, TLS, permission or security changes. Recording test doubles only until separate runtime authorization.
constraints: Only listed new paths; preserve B01/P01 and shared I06/I07/v1/API/DI/capability/readiness files
Unique slot matches I07 binding/tenant/company/actor/action/idempotency tuple; document/intent/source are conflict correlations
Explicit schema/version/binding/collation/index validation fails closed; lookup errors are never Absent
Preserve ordinal validated key semantics; no trimming/case folding or secret-derived database identity
Return reservation ownership only after confirmed commit acknowledgment; ambiguous commit/cancellation/duplicate/deadlock never grants dispatch or timeout takeover
No Committed writer, ERP procedure execution, receipt invention or automatic DDL; later executor must commit receipt with ERP effects atomically
No key reuse/delete/expiry or in-memory durability claims
No raw owner SQL, real rows, credentials, private paths or private fixture output in public artifacts
Offline tests do not establish SQL uniqueness/locking/durability/runtime acceptance; document delayed durability and deployment prerequisites
